invariants.text: A book can only be added if it does not already exist in the collection with the same ISBN.
A book's author must not be empty.
A book's genre must be one of the predefined genres in the system.
A user's email must be unique across all users.
Book.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each book must have a unique ISBN.
The category of a book must match one of the valid categories defined in the system.
The publication year of a book must be a positive integer between 1000 and 3000.
The system must persist book and user data across application executions.
The title of a book must not be empty.
User.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a book is added, its publication year must be greater than or equal to the earliest possible year (1000) and less than or equal to the latest possible year (3000).
